newsitem.title: USA: CME traders say USDA data bullish for pork bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME traders say USDA data bullish for pork bellies.

text.p: Chicago Mercantile Exchange traders said monthly cold storage data issued Friday by the U.S. Department of Agriculture was bullish for pork belly futures.

They estimated bellies would open 0.50 to 1.00 cent a lb higher Monday, boosted by news USDA had tabbed frozen pork belly stocks as of May 31, at 55.274 million lbs, the second lowest total for the date on record.
